notes: The target MvPowerSeries.pderiv takes the coefficient ring implicitly, so pderiv k i and pderiv R i become pderiv (R := k) i and pderiv (R := R) i throughout, including in theorem statements. The definition of pderiv is otherwise identical in the pinned and target Mathlib (only `variable (R) in` was dropped), so these are the same terms and the statements are unchanged in meaning. Inside one proof, the removed index-first MvPolynomial.coeff x is written as fun q => q.coeff x, the same coefficient. MvPowerSeries.coeff is unchanged and is not touched.
